question: What traditional and cosmic context frames the diagram being constructed?
premises: A distinction of tradition is invoked.
The earth is named in this context.
The locus is described as the abode of all arts.
inference: The construction is framed by traditional distinction and situated in the earth as the abode of all arts.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of kṣamā in this fragmentary verse is uncertain.
plain_english: By distinction of tradition, in the earth, the abode of all arts.
